sql: SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total_cents, o.tenant_id, o.placed_at, q.* FROM (SELECT * FROM shop.main.orders WHERE tenant_id = $1) o, (SELECT customers.id, customers.name, NULL AS email, customers.tenant_id, customers.created_at FROM (SELECT * FROM shop.main.customers WHERE tenant_id = $2) customers) q
